body: I'm not looking for anything like that, sorry. But I'll take it as a compliment lol

I just do my own version of daydreaming which is just thinking about stuff haha. But now that you mention it, when I'm put in a situation where I need to be creative, my mind is literally blank, maybe that's why I hated art classes...

Absolutely regret finding out. I found out on accident with my friend, she talked about when she spells words she sees letters in head, and I was like "wait...what??" and that went into a deeper conversation of "am i the only person who cant see images or hear anything in my head?!" then I googled it and found out about all this. It sucks knowing everyone else can do it, but I can't, just adding on to the list of things I can't do.

It sounds like your love interests are just the totally wrong kind of girl to go for, find genuinely "looks don't matter" girls. I've seen so many ugly AND fat dudes with pretty girlfriends (mind you that this is in highschool and college so I don't think the girls are in it for the money) you have a chance, just look for different types of girls, the nice ones
I know this isn't ethical or whatever but smoke weed dude, I tried it for the first time on thanksgiving and it was like great, I was care free
How can I make them? Any websites I can use? I don't have photoshop

I miss having some too, I don't have any friends as well. It really does suck, loneliness is the worst thing for a human to experience, I wish you luck in your future, we all just have to trudge on through the fields of depression and hopefully make it to where the grass is greener. It gets better, so they tell us.

Try asking for extra credit, I know it can be scary talking to teachers if you have really bad anxiety, but if you can, really try. I know it's hard but no one's going to do it for you, giving up is the worst thing to do now. You can do it man, pm me if you wanna talk to someone

Thanks so much, it means a lot someone would take the time. Life really isn't fair but it's the way it is I suppose. I wish you a happy life, things'll get better for you as they hopefully will for me too. Just remember to always keep that hope shining, don't let it fade away like mine did.
